Melee Low Effort Method (19+ kph) 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Nodon Spike Harness 
Perks
⬥ Vestments of Havoc Robe Top 
    • Ultimatums 4  + Crackling 4  
    • Equilibrium 4  > Biting 4 
⬥ Vestments of Havoc Robe Bottom 
    • Clear Headed 4 
    • Bulwark 4  + Absorbative 1 
Abilities
⬥ Darkness 
⬥ Chaos Roar 
⬥ Greater Bone Shield 
Other
⬥ Masterwork 2H Sword 
    • This is required for the method to work
⬥ Pray  and 
    •  has not been tested and may not work
⬥ Hellhound 
⬥ Totem of Vitality  and Ogre flask (thermal)  required.
⬥ Teleporting to War's Retreat  after every kill to replenish prayer, adrenaline, familiar and player health, and reset cooldowns.
